The television series "José Rizal" premiered on October 20, 2014 on GMA Network's Telebabad line up, replacing "My Destiny." It concluded on November 14, 2014 with a total of 20 episodes and was replaced by "More Than Words" in its timeslot. In March 2016, the series was released on DVD by GMA Records Home Video and is currently streaming on YouTube. The series follows the life of Philippine hero José Rizal, portrayed by Alden Richards, as he leaves his family to fulfill his studies and career abroad, endures homesickness, and maintains a long-distance relationship with the woman he loves. Upon returning home, he uses the knowledge and skills he learned abroad to help improve the lives of his family and countrymen. The supporting cast includes Kylie Padilla, Eula Valdez, Solenn Heussaff, Jaclyn Jose, and Ricardo Cepeda, among others.
